subject: history

items.q: Was the transatlantic slave trade a minor part of the economy?
items.correct: No — it was central to the economies of Britain and the Americas.
items.random_wrong: It only involved a few hundred people.
items.why: The 'triangular trade' generated huge wealth and shaped port cities.

items.correct: Due to enslaved people's resistance, campaigning and economic factors over decades.
items.misconception: Simply because people suddenly realised it was wrong.
items.random_wrong: Because it became illegal worldwide overnight.
items.why: Abolition was a long struggle involving rebellions, abolitionists and changing economics.
